Add RoPEMultiSpeed widget for multiple rotation speeds section

Replace the old RoPEDistanceSensitivity widget with a new
RoPEMultiSpeed widget that uses 16 dimension pairs (matching real
RoPE's geometric frequency distribution) and a fixed 100-position
window. Presets are organized as tabbed examples with "Go to Next
Tab" progression:

- Close/Medium/Wide focus: show how zeroing fast pairs widens the
  attention window (all 16 → last 8 → last 2 pairs)
- Sharper medium: same range as medium but steeper dropoff shape
- Two-stage dropoff: fast initial drop then steady floor from slow
  pairs, showing "fast then flat then slow" attention

All presets verified by simulation to be smooth and oscillation-free.
Rewrite the MDX section to explain single-speed limitations and how
mixing speeds shapes attention curves.
